Selected evidence notes (exact):
- Durable object schema: src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts:117 (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deliveries ...). No `task_results`/`task_delivery` tables present.  
- Completion persisted before sends: src/tools/task-tools.ts (completeGeneralTask) — ledger.claimTaskCompletion & ledger.completeGeneralTask occur before send calls (tools/task-tools.ts:409-418) and DO completeGeneralTask at src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts:1518.  
- Telegram send wrappers do not write ledger entries (src/telegram/send.ts:50-90).  
- Dispatch acceptance ordering: src/tasks/processor.ts:361-388 (dispatch(...) then ledger.markQueueDispatched/completeQueueEvent).  
- agent_end whitelist: src/tasks/transitions.ts:5 (ACTIVE_TASK_STATUSES = ['accepted','queued','running']) and observability/task-activity.ts behavior.
